limits: RDM5 bad normals are replaced with zero; retail propagates NaNs.
High-edge light-grid sampling stays in bounds rather than reproducing retail out-of-range reads.
NPC captures settle the transporter effect with 600 retail waits and 300 fnTech3 waits; idle animation timing is not synchronized.
No pixel-identical full-frame claim; complete effect/shadow and broader platform/installation coverage remain open.
Retail probes use developer 0 because developer logging plus logfile recurses; its texture-pack memory requirement is met with zone=128/hunk=256 MB.
One temporary probe exceeded fnTech3 startup-command limit; final runs put non-startup settings in efconfig.cfg and remove stale captures/logs before launch.

tests.intermediateFailure: An already-running Python test process retained the earlier RTCW fixture without the new light helper include. The corrected fixture passes its seven focused tests; the final full run includes that fix.

configuration.notes: Other runtime settings, including the save and waits, are retained in the per-engine configuration/console logs and commands.
